important_instructions: Candidates should read all instructions carefully and ensure they meet the eligibility criteria before applying; NABCONS verifies eligibility at the interview/joining stage. Selected candidates must not take up any other part-time or full-time employment, assignment, or business during their contract with NABCONS; doing so without prior information will result in automatic termination and possible claims for compensation/damages. Applications received after the due date will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: NABCONS Salary / Professional Fees 2026
content_sections.text: NABCONS has not specified fixed pay scales for any of these 6 posts. As per both notifications, selected candidates will be paid a consolidated professional fee based on their experience, educational qualification, and overall suitability for the post, and the amount will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and last drawn salary. Tax will be deducted at source under the applicable provisions of the Income Tax Act. Exact fee figures are not specified in either notification.

content_sections.heading: NABCONS Contract Period
content_sections.text: Project Manager & Project Consultant (Pulses Mission PMU): Initial contract period of 11 months, which may be extended based on project requirement and performance, or will be co-terminus with the project period. Procurement Expert, Finance & Accounts Expert, Senior Consultant, Junior Consultant (Livestock Health Division PMU): Contract period till 15 June 2027, which may similarly be extended or made co-terminus with the project. NABCONS may terminate the contract at any time without prior notice or reason. In the normal course, termination will be with three months' notice within the contract period.

content_sections.heading: NABCONS Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview; shortlisting is based on qualification, suitability, and experience after preliminary screening. Shortlisted candidates may also be assessed for proficiency in MS Office and data management. The interview may be conducted in person or through virtual mode. Candidates must submit self-attested copies of educational qualification and experience certificates at the time of interview; original documents are required for verification. Final appointment is subject to being found medically fit through a medical test protocol upon reporting at the place of posting. The decision of the selection committee and NABCONS management is final and binding; no correspondence will be entertained regarding eligibility, shortlisting, or selection outcome.

faq.question: Q1. What is NABCONS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a set of two notifications from NABARD Consultancy Services (NABCONS) inviting online applications for 6 Project Based Contract Staff posts - 2 under the PMU for the Mission for Aatmanirbharta in Pulses, and 4 under the PMU for vaccine and ear tag procurement in the Livestock Health Division, DAHD.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NABCONS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies: Project Manager (1), Project Consultant (1), Procurement Expert (1), Finance & Accounts Expert (1), Senior Consultant (1), and Junior Consultant (1).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NABCONS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for both drives is 16 August 2026, midnight.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for NABCONS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It varies by post: MBA/PGDM for Project Manager and Senior/Junior Consultant roles; M.Sc./B.Sc. Agriculture for Project Consultant; MBA (Finance) for Procurement Expert; and CA/ICWA/MBA (Finance) for Finance & Accounts Expert.

faq.question: Q5. What is the place of posting for NABCONS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: New Delhi/Delhi, though candidates can be posted anywhere in India depending on project requirement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for NABCONS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NABCONS will pay a consolidated professional fee based on the candidate's experience, qualification, and suitability, commensurate with experience and last drawn salary. An exact salary figure is not specified in the notifications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the contract period for NABCONS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 11 months (extendable/co-terminus with the project) for Project Manager and Project Consultant; till 15 June 2027 (extendable) for the four Livestock Health Division PMU posts.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for NABCONS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By filling the Microsoft Forms link specific to the post applied for, available on the NABCONS website, before 16 August 2026 midnight. No other mode of application is accepted.
